instruction: I packed twelve mushrooms into a tiny frying pan, and now they are sitting in a puddle instead of browning. Should I add more oil?
I poured all the stock into my risotto at once and walked away until it dried out. Why is the texture uneven?
My cake looked cooked outside, so I removed it without checking the middle. It collapsed into a wet crater. What should I change next time?
My program opens the same configuration file inside a loop a million times. I bought more RAM but it is still slow. What am I missing?
I fixed a failing test by deleting its assertion. The test suite is green now, so can I merge the change?
I copied the same validation code into fourteen functions. Now every bug fix needs fourteen edits. Should I copy it into a fifteenth function too?
My presentation is tomorrow. I made sixty slides full of paragraphs and have not rehearsed once. Should I spend tonight adding animations?
I keep missing deadlines because I agree to every new task without checking my calendar. Should I just promise everyone faster delivery?
